name: online-game
description: A complete 1–4 player local-multiplayer 3D browser game console featuring a PlayStation / Google Playground-inspired 3D carousel home menu, 5 full 3D games, and a 60 Hz hardware controller bridge for Sony PS3 DualShock 3 / Sixaxis gamepads powered by an **ESP32 (Classic Bluetooth)** or **ESP32-S3 (USB Host)**.
